helpers.name: block_state_string
helpers.doc: Serializes a block state's full registry name and properties, or returns None for an unknown state id.

helpers.name: item_stack_in_tag
helpers.doc: Test an item stack against merged item tags; None when authoritative tags are unavailable, including on clients.

helpers.name: item_crafting_remainder
helpers.doc: Returns the item's crafting remainder as a count-one plain stack, or None for no remainder or an unknown item. Horizon stores only a remainder item id; non-default template counts and components are not represented.

helpers.name: block_item
helpers.doc: Returns the item registry name for a namespaced block name, including minecraft:air when the known block has no item; returns None for an unknown block.
